description:
The map of the Mission 1 (Ryusei) in Super Robot Taisen: Original Generation (GBA).

Note that this background is 32x24 and doesn't loop, so it works best with a custom scroll setting (as Variable 3 or 4 for both horizontal and vertical scroll).
